description: FREE headline payload-budget pre-check of one submitted payload (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns the verdict line, the payload's token count under the pinned cl100k_base tokenizer, and the excess figure only — no shaped payload. The full signed report with the shaped payload and drop receipt is the paid token_efficiency_budget call.

budget_tokens.description: The token budget the payload must fit, counted under the published pinned tokenizer (cl100k_base). No default: a call without a valid budget_tokens is a free validation refusal.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

keep_fields.description: Optional field paths protected from shaping operations.

payload.description: The one payload to check, as text or as JSON text. Processed in memory only and never stored.

reserve_tokens.description: Optional reserve subtracted from budget_tokens to form the effective budget.

name: token_efficiency_precheck
